name: Nautilus
author: E. T. Carter
description: The cross-section of a chambered shell seen straight down the whorl: grand annular chambers flooded with pearly light compress septum by septum into a black focal depth, while one bright siphuncle channel pierces every wall at a single fixed angle. The vessel sinks forever along the scale axis — nothing rotates, nothing translates.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the chambers sink toward the dark center of the whorl.

params.label: Chamber density
params.effect: Chambers per scale octave — low keeps a few grand vaults, high packs more septa into the descent.

params.label: Seam glow
params.effect: Brightness of the thin nacre seams arcing between chambers.

params.label: Pearl
params.effect: Strength of the pearly interior fill flooding each chamber — at 0 only the seams and channel glow.
